source_of_hypothesis: Original completed AEF 64-task real PhysX run 37938466825: robust 47/64 successes and 25 reads vs original public observer 49/64, 53 reads; task loss concentrated in a subset of slow-PD StackCube and cannot be re-used as an independent test.
hypothesis: Native geometry-bounded all-history action need not be task-compatible; more precise tolerance for contact-rich stacking can recover genuine task outcomes without sacrificing all privileged-read economy.
new_method: P-AEF, same full finite SE3 history + same public XYZ sensor as original AEF, identical native robotics chart. New published arm uses precommitted stricter native all-history commanded-target bounds for StackCube: max_inf_xyz_target_error=0.0125m, max_SO3_geodesic_target_error=0.025rad. PullCube unchanged 0.05m/0.05rad. If robust common action infeasible, fall back to frozen original public full-history inference if unique; else count one actual native-private controller target read.

faults.truth: physically dispatched applied native arm action OR zero-hold, balanced AA/AH/HA/HH per task

physical_dynamics_modes.assignment: precommitted deterministic seed //4 parity, fully balanced across four truth groups

public_information: All three public methods receive exactly TWO actual measured achieved XYZ events from a known-delivered neutral arm step4. No hidden target getter except explicitly counted fallback; auditor may use getter only AFTER physical step.
primary_comparison: new P-AEF vs old AEF on all 64 exact frozen task/reset identities; 32 per task, 2 PD modes. Report original success discordances, read difference, any new wrong admissions; zero-tuned test data.
secondary_comparison: new P-AEF vs original same-XYZ public observer, separately task-aware, fixed authoritative-reader
cluster_unit: original 64 unique task/reset seeds, not 704 independent episodes
success_requirement: Meaningful net task or read/sensing-cost Pareto advantage over old AEF and strongest same-information original baseline, with no new confidently wrong latent-history authorization; significance/effect bound calculated after outcomes but not overclaimed
limits: Task label is a public prior and fixed per-task precision does NOT constitute a learned regret predictor, context-aware safety certificate, independent lab adoption, general VLA performance, or established main-conference novelty. A negative result will be published.
